item.title: New impact fee may replace land acquisition fees
item.description: The town of Longboat Key is switching up how fees for new development are issued and what the money will be used for.At the Feb. 2 Town Commission meeting, commissioners passed an ordinance on first reading that would replace land acquisition fees with a parks and recreation impact fee. item.title: Buttonwood residents get sneak peek of stormwater improvements
item.description: Fifteen more stormwater inlets. A raised road. item.description: The Tipsea Gypsea lies beached on a sandbar, two anchor lines extending from the bow of the 45-foot sailboat.On the hull, a bright orange sticker has been placed declaring the vessel must be removed. item.title: Longboat's Spanish Main looks for normalcy a year after the storms
item.description: The rebuild continues at Spanish Main Yacht Club, one of the hardest hit communities from the 2024 hurricanes.Sixteen months after storm surge from Hurricane Helene flooded Longboat Key, contractors are still spotted routinely coming in and out of the community. item.title: Cursive writing requirements would change if proposed legislation passes
item.description: Lakewood Ranch's Mark Eubanks, a sixth grader at Dan R. Nolan Middle, has memorized how to write his signature in cursive.
